name: Yaksha's Mask
description:
Physical DMG dealt is converted to Anemo DMG. You also gain +1 Extra Action.
After the character to which this is attached uses a Skill: Switch to the next character and attach 8 stacks of Anemo Plunging Attack to self.
Duration (Rounds): 2
